source_authority.incident_summary: Generator/validator asymmetry: validators are deterministic, generators non-deterministic; every fix adds a downstream validator and none constrain the generator (A1b:F-A1b-005 generator-silent Phase-7 ID drift caught post-hoc; A12:F-A12-03 multi-release harden-orchestration-around-broken-comparator anti-pattern).

reason: Meta-pattern, not a single scanner input. This is the architectural meta-driver describing the shape of every other recurrence (each fix adds a downstream validator; none constrain the non-deterministic generator). R1.4 tool-write generator-side constraints address it structurally (attested in R1.4 Findings), so it has no isolated fixture input with verifiable expected values.
